scientific_integrity: Exact sharp moment and three-term deficit proved analytically for all integer dimensions >=2. Computational tests are diagnostic, not infinite proofs. Historical equivalence risk remains, including an older inaccessible general moment paper.
scientific_limitations: Real standard Gaussian measure, trace-free symmetric quadratic coefficients, first-plus-second harmonic Gaussian polynomials, fourth moments only. The metric stability constant for distance to the equality manifold is not optimized.
title: Sharp fourth moments and forced linear mixing in Gaussian harmonic quadratics
